name: Seshasayee Paper & Boards Ltd
about: Seshasayee Paper & Boards is engaged in the business of manufacture and sale of printing and writing paper.SPBL is the flagship company of SPB-ESVIN Group headquarted at Chennai. The company was incorporated in the year 1960, Seshasayee Paper has six decades of experience in the Indian paper industry.
keyPoints:
Products & Brands
The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing and sale of paper and paper boards under Sprint, SPD, Color Sprint, and Success brands. [1] [2]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.77 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.18% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.72.5 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 11.3% of profits over last 3 years
